summary: Hunts Run is a stream in Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, described as a tributary of Sullivan Branch that flows through Davidson Township. The note says its watershed has a low pH and poor water quality. It also lists the main local rock formations and soil associations.
one_line: Hunts Run is a Pennsylvania stream, a tributary of Sullivan Branch in Sullivan County, with poor water quality.
key_facts: Hunts Run is a tributary of Sullivan Branch in Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, United States.
Hunts Run flows through Davidson Township.
The stream has a low pH and poor water quality.
The main rock formations in the area of Hunts Run are the Huntley Mountain Formation and the Burgoon Sandstone.
The main soil associations near Hunts Run are the Deep-Wellsboro-Oquaga association, the Morris association, and the Oquaga association.
